summary: Frontend-only landing page for VirtualProperty.my tested end-to-end via Playwright at 1440/1024/768/390 widths. Page loads with no console errors, hero headline renders, Lenis smooth scroll works (real wheel events scrolled from 0 to 12000+ of 13584 px), sticky nav compacts on scroll, all nav links (nav-link-what-we-do/experiences/who-we-help/about and nav-start-project) scroll to the correct sections (offset -10 matches config), mobile hamburger opens mobile-menu and mobile-link-* + mobile-start-project both scroll and close the menu, transformation phase testids 0-5 render, capability rows 0-3 interact, project cards + CTAs render, segments 0-5 render, whatsapp-float and final-whatsapp-btn hrefs correctly point to https://wa.me/60172029996, Novo Reperio outbound CTA is hidden (0 elements) as expected when URL empty, footer shows 2026 + 'Powered by Novo Reperio Sdn Bhd'. Conversion funnel: goal-* auto-advances to Step 2, deliverable-* auto-advances to Step 3, back buttons work, empty submit shows field-name-error + field-email-error, invalid email shows validation ('Please enter a valid email.'), valid submit reaches Step 4 with funnel-whatsapp button whose href contains 60172029996, selected goal ('Market a Development') and deliverable ('Digital Twin'). No horizontal overflow at 1440/1024/768/390.
critical_code_review_comments: Testability note (non-blocking): Mobile menu links use testids 'mobile-link-<id>' and 'mobile-start-project' (not the same 'nav-link-<id>' / 'nav-start-project' as desktop). The review request referred to nav-link-* generically; current split is cleaner but worth documenting in the testing brief so tests target the correct id per viewport.

ConversionFunnel.jsx: submit() sets step=3 in finally{} even if fetch() itself succeeds/fails — acceptable because FORM_ENDPOINT is empty, but when a real endpoint is wired later, network failures will still show a success screen. Consider surfacing an error toast on non-OK response.

App.js does not import a 'lenis/dist/lenis.css'-style CSS reset; scrolling still works but Lenis recommends html { overflow: hidden } handling — current behaviour is fine but keep in mind for iOS momentum scrolling.
PROJECT_LINKS and NOVO_REPERIO_URL empty strings correctly hide/fallback CTAs — verified in DOM.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All key data-testids resolved and behaved as spec'd. Note: goals/deliverables use small 260ms setTimeout before advancing step — allow ~600ms between clicks in scripts. Mobile testids differ (mobile-link-*, mobile-start-project). Real wheel-event driven scroll works (Lenis is NOT blocking scroll for real users).
